content: DRAFT For inter - partition routing paths, the call to the function PduR_<User:Up>CancelTransmit shall only execute code that is as signed to the same ECUC partition. PduR shall not call the <Provider:LoTp>_CancelTransmit in the same context.

For inter-partition routing paths, the call to the function PduR_- <User:Up>CancelTransmit shall only execute code that is assigned to the same ECUC partition. PduR shall not call the <Provider:LoTp>_CancelTransmit in the same context.

For inter-partition routing paths, the call to the function PduR_- <User:Up/UpTp>CancelTransmit shall only execute code that is assigned to the same ECUC partition. PduR shall not call the <Provider:Lo/LoTp>_Cancel Transmit in the call context of PduR_<User:Up/UpTp>CancelTransmit . PduR shall call <Provider:Lo/LoTp>_CancelTransmit in the ECUC partition context of the <Provider:Lo/LoTp> module (in fact of the ECUC partition context defined via the EcucPduDefaultPartitionRef or the EcucPduDedicatedPartitionRef of the PduRDestPduRef ).
